page.overview:
Who is Carlos?

" During the episode, King Koopa announces he will be giving away four tickets to the LA Zoo. The Troopa who would get tickets will be determined by the seat labeled on the card Ratso has.

After pulling the card away from Ratso, Koopa calls on the Troopa on the seat labeled "Blue 5," who is revealed to be Carlos. King Koopa asks Carlos to do the "Koopa Salute," which he refuses to do.

After King Koopa gives Carlos the tickets, King Koopa asks Carlos if he is excited, to which he responds by saying he is bored.
